messages.subject: Global Energy Transition Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Strategic Partnerships
messages.body:
Dear Harry James Group Team,

Your global energy-transition executive-search practice is closely aligned with my background in ESG, external affairs, government relations and strategic stakeholder leadership. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility for regulatory and government engagement, ESG and social performance, corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates across energy transition, renewables and infrastructure where institutional trust and coordinated execution are critical. I am internationally mobile, with Saudi Arabia and the UAE among my priority markets.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
